mapper.sql: user_id, role_id, username, password_hash, full_name, gender, birthday, email, phone, [status], created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE username LIKE ('%' + (#{username}) + '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( role_id, username, password_hash, full_name, gender, birthday, email, phone, [status], created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{roleId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{fullName}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{status}, GETDATE(), GETDATE() )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET role_id = #{roleId}, username = #{username}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, full_name = #{fullName}, gender = #{gender}, birthday = #{birthday}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, [status] = #{status}, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
